clips.title: Control room on a seeded project, real timeline
clips.notes: Hook: room first. Hover timeline blocks; no edits required.

clips.title: Director mode panel (free surface only)
clips.notes: Director proposals are client-side only and a send bills a model call. This take films the Director tab (cost geometry + empty composer) without sending. Ghosted old vs new / Apply requires a live turn — do not run without explicit approval. See README.

clips.title: A/B or mix playing — picture for the listen beat
clips.notes: Foley mix selected + play + brief Original toggle. Product audio bed is exported separately.

clips.title: Free nudge: drag / arrow an event
clips.notes: Draft-only drag and Shift+arrow. Never commit (also free, but mutates server versions).

clips.title: Spend tab: budget, thresholds, transactions
clips.notes: Read-only on the warm primary seed (budget + thresholds). The Inhaler has richer ledger rows but a broken timeline poisons the Spend panel via ancillaryFailed.

clips.title: Evidence tab: loudness, true peak, shot-to-shot
clips.notes: QA measurements already on the seed.

clips.title: Artifacts tab: full inventory with sizes
clips.notes: Dossier composes slowly (HEAD per object) — wait for the table, not 'Composing…'.
